dct_title_s: Theatrum Belli inter Imperat. CAROL. VI. et SULT. ACHMET IV. in partibus regnorum SERVIAE et BOSNIAE / ex authenticis subsidÿs delineatum a Ioh. Fr. Öttingero Loc. ten. Imper.
dct_description_sm: Date of publication from depiction of events of the Austro-Russian-Turkish War (1735-39).; Shows "Theatrum Belli" title in decorative cartouche within map.; Shows additional titles above map.; Includes 15 maps and views (plus one panel of text) of towns (scales not given) at either side and beneath the map: USSITZA (Uzice), BRODT (Slavonski Brod), WIHAZ (Bihac), ZWORNEK (Zvornik), RATSCHA (Raca), SABATZ (Sabac), BELGRAD (Belgrade), ORSAVA (Orsova), WIDDIN (Vidin), NICOPOLIS (Nikopol), NISSA (Nis), CHATCHEK (Cacak), SERAGLIO (Sarajevo), KRAKOIEVAZ (Kragujevac) and VALIOVA (Valjevo).; Examples of the map are known lacking the privilege and with additional town plans - compare an example held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Cartes et plans, CPL GE DD-2987 (5894 B).
1 map on 2 sheets : copperplate engraving, hand color 29 x 81 cm, on sheet 52 x 113 cm
